note: American Chemical Society primary journals (JACS, Nano Letters, J. Phys. Chem., Chem. Mater.). Fills the chemistry-primary gap: registry covers physics (APS/AIP/IOP), bio (Cell/eLife/PLOS/bioRxiv) and chem-preprints (chemrxiv) but no peer-reviewed chemistry primary. Evaluator egress walled (code 000), so writers vet via proxy at first citation.

Royal Society of Chemistry primary journals (Chemical Science [gold OA], Chem. Commun., Energy & Environmental Science). Complements ACS for the same chemistry-primary gap; EES is a top sustainable-energy venue relevant to the CH/climate beat. Evaluator egress walled (code 000); writers vet via proxy.
